extracted.intended_audience: people looking for live comedy events and ticket buyers in Sacramento, CA
extracted.subtask_description: A local event-calendar page listing upcoming comedy shows in Sacramento with dates, venues, performers, and ticketing information. Helps users find, browse, and purchase tickets for stand-up, improv, and other comedy events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confirmed dates, venues, and performers
rubrics_metrics.description: Browse an up-to-date calendar of upcoming shows with confirmed dates, venues, and performers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listings are presented only for events with confirmed dates and venues to help planning; updated regularly as new shows and tour dates are publicly announced.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chronological organization
rubrics_metrics.description: Events are organized chronologically so visitors can quickly find shows happening tonight, this week, or later this season.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use date filters (start/end) or browse the calendar by month/day to locate events by time frame.

rubrics_metrics.name: Event attributes displayed
rubrics_metrics.description: Each event listing shows date/time, performer name(s), venue name, capacity, and full address (e.g., 'Capacity: 240', '95825, 2100 Arden Way, Sacramento, CA, US').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consistent display of these attributes helps users assess logistics (when/where/how large the venue is).

rubrics_metrics.name: Ticketing details and availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Listings include ticket price indications ('From $37'), average price ('Avg. price ~ $61'), and availability counts or flags ('151 tickets available', 'Limited availability', '3 tickets remaining!').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Price ranges, average price, and explicit remaining-ticket counts/limited-availability notices are provided so buyers can judge cost and urgency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of comedy covered
rubrics_metrics.description: The calendar covers stand-up comedy, improv performances, open mic nights, touring comedy specials, and themed showcase events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content explicitly calls out multiple event formats so users know the breadth of programming (local showcases, touring headliners, improv, themed nights).

rubrics_metrics.name: Venue coverage and categorization
rubrics_metrics.description: Shows are grouped by venue type: dedicated comedy clubs, theaters, and event venues; the page lists venues and upcoming show counts (e.g., 'Laughs Unlimited Comedy Club and Lounge — Upcoming Comedy Shows: 131').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Providing venue pages and counts helps users browse by location and assess how active each venue is.

rubrics_metrics.name: Browse by performer and venue
rubrics_metrics.description: Users can browse confirmed comedy shows by venue, performer, and time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Performances are listed by confirmed date and venue for convenience in following shows by both date and comedian.

rubrics_metrics.name: Year-round scheduling and seasonality note
rubrics_metrics.description: Comedy shows are available year-round; spring, summer and fall tend to have the biggest concentration of touring comedians.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This sets user expectations about frequency and peak seasons for touring acts versus local showcases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Platform independence disclaimer
rubrics_metrics.description: Comedy.Tickets is an independent event calendar featuring confirmed comedy show listings in Sacramento. We are not affiliated with individual venues or performers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals editorial independence and explains that listings and ticket options may be sourced from third parties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ticket marketplace assurances / marketing claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Claims about ticket marketplace: '100% Authentic & Valid Tickets', 'Buyer Guarantee on Every Order', 'No Hidden Fees', 'Transparent Pricing', 'Verified Sellers Network', 'Secure Payments by Global Leaders', 'Event Cancellation', 'Delivery Protection', 'Trusted Across North America'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are presented as assurances to buyers about ticket legitimacy, payment security, pricing transparency, and protections; treat as vendor marketing claims rather than independent guarantees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Newsletter subscription for updates and deals
rubrics_metrics.description: Join our newsletter now to stay up to date on all upcoming comedy shows in 2026–2027 plus the occasional special offer, discount comedy tickets, and VIP packages!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Newsletter is positioned as a channel for receiving timely updates, notable event alerts, and promotional offers.
